Call Us
Speak directly with our scheduling team to book your pet's appointment.
Email Us
Send us a message and we'll get back to you within one business day.
Schedule an Appointment | AVSC
Book a specialty veterinary appointment at AVSC. Contact our team by phone or email to schedule neurology, oncology, surgery, or rehabilitation services.
Schedule an Appointment
Our team is ready to help schedule the right specialty care for your pet.

Referral Information
Most of our services require a referral from your primary veterinarian. If you haven't already, please ask your vet to send referral notes and medical records prior to your appointment. This helps us prepare the best care plan for your pet.
